question: Is the existing authored Executioner's Seal tenth-Attack cadence upper-capacity envelope large, inactive, viable, naturally acquired and Scoreline-separated enough to justify identity-safe acquisition/proc telemetry before any causal ablation row?
competingOptions: authorise only exact ownership-timing and relic-proc telemetry plus a disabled-effect identity preflight
close the Executioner's Seal cadence family and continue with another materially different mechanism inside issue #421
record an inconclusive result at the frozen cap

sourceFilter.selectionRule: Start from the exact current-main BalancePilot Dusk bonus relic list. Remove Shatterer's Crown, closed by issue #421 natural-effect CRN, and Prism Charm, an immutable tested issue #524 target. Do not inspect support until the remaining list is frozen.
sourceFilter.result: Executioner's Seal is the sole existing authored Dusk-favoured relic without a current issue #421 package decision.

definition.name: Executioner's Seal
definition.text: Every 10th Attack you play deals double damage.

candidate.mediator: The existing per-combat Attack counter reaches a positive multiple of 10 while the relic is owned.
candidate.payoff: The existing combat rule sets seal_mult to 2 for that Attack only, doubling its damage effect without changing its card definition, Energy, Ward, draw, healing, status, offer or rarity.
candidate.mechanisticJustification: This is an authored cadence/counter mechanism already favoured by Dusk policy scoring. It rewards sustained Attack throughput and is materially different from Shatter thresholds, named-card setup, producer-to-next-Attack bits and same-instance repeats.
candidate.claimBoundary: A source branch is not proof of a live proc. This screen uses final ownership plus exact play counts only as a conservative upper-capacity condition. It cannot establish ownership timing, a tenth-Attack proc, damage effect, causal complementarity, package admission or product quality.

closedDirections: heavy-Attack relay, reseam break and Honing repeat
Ward, Kindle, Afterimage, Cracked, Resonant Lance and tested issue #524/#525 paths
changing the tenth-Attack cadence, relic rarity, score, offer or ownership path

fixedCausalFactors.executionersSealDoubleDamage: Existing authored effect fixed on in all cached rows; no factor is implemented or varied here.
fixedCausalFactors.scorelinePayoff: A separate causal factor fixed by the exact baseline content and rules; never varied or estimated.
fixedCausalFactors.afterimagePayoff: A separate causal factor fixed independently by the exact baseline content and rules; never varied or estimated.
fixedCausalFactors.acquisitionPriority: Fixed at the exact current path.
fixedCausalFactors.faultlineRarity: Fixed by the baseline content SHA.
fixedCausalFactors.wardSetupPriority: Fixed at the exact current/null path.
fixedCausalFactors.policyMapping: The closed Momentum remap is absent.

upperCapacityDefinitions.ownerRow: The final whole-run relic inventory contains Executioner's Seal. This may post-date an earlier fight and therefore is an upper bound, never exact exposure.
upperCapacityDefinitions.attackCapableRow: At least one fight contains at least 10 authored Attack play events.
upperCapacityDefinitions.potentialActiveRow: Both ownerRow and attackCapableRow are true. No proc or ownership-timing claim is made.
upperCapacityDefinitions.robustOwnerPolicy: At least two of four frozen rows are owner rows.
upperCapacityDefinitions.attackCapablePolicy: At least two of four frozen rows are attack-capable.
upperCapacityDefinitions.potentialActivePolicy: At least two of four frozen rows are potential-active.
upperCapacityDefinitions.exactInactivePolicy: None of four frozen rows is potential-active; the upper-bound activation condition is absent.
upperCapacityDefinitions.ambiguousPolicy: Exactly one of four frozen rows is potential-active.
upperCapacityDefinitions.viablePotentialActivePolicy: The policy is potential-active and has at least one potential-active Vow-5 row whose outcome is win.
upperCapacityDefinitions.scorelineRoutePolicy: At least two of four frozen rows play Chisel before a later Faultline in the same fight.
upperCapacityDefinitions.candidateOnlyPolicy: Potential-active for Seal but not Scoreline-route active.
upperCapacityDefinitions.scorelineOnlyPolicy: Scoreline-route active but not potential-active for Seal.

interactionAndAlias.interactions: None. No factor varies and no causal interaction is estimated.
interactionAndAlias.upperBoundAlias: Final ownership is deliberately aliased with unknown acquisition time and is used only in the direction that can overstate activation. A failure is decisive; a pass authorises exact telemetry, not a causal claim.
interactionAndAlias.scorelineInterference: Candidate-only, Scoreline-only and Jaccard gates use the same frozen policy identities. Scoreline payoff remains fixed and no joint cell is constructed.
interactionAndAlias.staging: Source and upper-capacity evidence precede exact ownership/proc telemetry. Whole-run ablation is forbidden until that telemetry and current/null identity pass.

baseline.name: current-main root-551 Duskblade Vow-5 natural reward/economy rectangle

traceEvidence.identityRule: Every current trace row must exactly equal its cached current-main path, RNG, policy and result after trace and row-label fields are removed.

cohort.identity: The exact complete current-main first-look rectangle is reused. No policy or seed is added, removed, selected or replaced.

estimands.unit: Policy identity with the frozen two-of-four robustness rule.
estimands.sourceUniqueness: Exact Dusk bonus relic set, closed targets and remaining candidate.
estimands.primary: Exact robust-owner, attack-capable, potential-active, exact-inactive and ambiguous policy counts and identities.
estimands.reachability: Exact policies with any natural final Seal acquisition and robust final ownership.
estimands.viability: Exact potential-active policies with at least one potential-active winning Vow-5 row.
estimands.separation: Exact candidate-only, Scoreline-only, cross-active and Jaccard policy-set statistics.
estimands.notEstimated: No exact proc, acquisition time, damage, causal payoff, duration, RandomBuild, Ashwarden, detector, protected-seed or product effect is estimated.

estimator.method: Deterministic current-main source assertions, exact same-fight Attack counts and exact policy-set arithmetic.
estimator.model: None. No bootstrap, fitted model, optimiser, ML or RL component is used.
estimator.firstLook: One source-selected existing candidate, one immutable trace and one complete first look. No cadence, relic or cohort is changed after counts are visible.
estimator.stopping: Authorise exact telemetry only if every gate passes; otherwise close the existing Seal cadence or record inconclusive at the cap.

gates.provenance: The 16 active/inactive/ownership/capacity and eight viability/two-sided-separation minima reuse the frozen 64-policy first-look scale. The 0.75 Jaccard ceiling and one immutable baseline fault are unchanged.

decisionRules.success: Every source, owner-reachability, attack-capacity, potential-active, inactive, viability, two-sided Scoreline-separation and reliability gate passes.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Add only observation-only Seal acquisition/proc telemetry and a binary research ablation whose current level exactly preserves the authored effect and whose off level suppresses only seal_mult=2. Prove omitted/current path, RNG, policy and result identity; no-owner controls must be exact, and focused tenth-Attack surfaces must isolate only the registered damage multiplier before any equal-cohort CRN ablation row. Do not change cadence, relic scoring, rarity, offers or ownership.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close the existing Executioner's Seal cadence family and continue with the next materially different source- and evidence-backed mechanism inside issue #421. Do not lower the tenth-Attack cadence, force ownership, alter scoring or add another cadence relic.
decisionRules.inconclusive: The current-main source, immutable trace or deterministic screen cannot produce a complete decision before the numeric wall-time cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record the inconclusive result at the cap without telemetry, ablation, simulator spend, trace extension or protected seeds.

methodBoundary: Deterministic Python owns source selection, source assertions, trace validation, upper-capacity classification and stop/go. No model context, human label, ML, RL, optimiser or adaptive candidate iteration enters the decision.
